curation.lead:
Ghislaine Maxwell, daughter of British media owner Robert Maxwell, was convicted in December 2021 on five of six federal counts including sex trafficking of a minor in the conspiracy operated by Jeffrey Epstein. According to court filings in Ali Karimi v. Deutsche Bank, she is described as the Epstein associate and alleged fixer charged by federal prosecutors [OffshoreAlert:Ali-Karimi-v-DB]. Depositions, civil complaints, and contemporaneous emails document her presence in Epstein's financial, legal, and logistical arrangements across two decades, including direct instruction of at least one victim on Little St. James in 2006 [Finding #3209].

Documentary records place Maxwell on Epstein's Palm Beach house bank account as of 2005 [Finding #1346], in receipt of a $220,000 January 2006 internal transfer from Forums LLC to her JPMorgan Private Bank account [EFTA01524286], and in a 2003 co-trustee role on Epstein's 2001 Trust One alongside Darren Indyke [EFTA01266298]. Her FEC donations of $2,300 to Hillary Clinton for President (March 2007) and $5,000 to King for Congress (September 2004) align in committee and timing with donations from Indyke, Richard Kahn, and Anthony Barrett [Finding #451]. Maxwell's own corporate entities include Ghislaine Corp. (FL 1995-1998), Ellmax Enterprise (UK 08321238), Terramar UK (08661523), and the TerraMar Project [Finding #515][Finding #4905].
curation.system_role: Convicted co-conspirator holding formal trust, banking, and corporate-entity positions within Epstein's structures, and a documented social connector between those structures and political, royal, and business figures.

sections.title: Documented Conduct and Depositions
sections.content:
The Priscilla Doe v. Epstein civil complaint describes a 2006 trip to Little St. James Island in the U.S. Virgin Islands on which Maxwell instructed the plaintiff on how Jeffrey Epstein preferred to be sexually serviced, described oral techniques, demonstrated manually, and ensured that young women were "constantly on call" to service Epstein [Finding #3209]. Court records characterize Maxwell's manner as "serious" and as instilling "genuine fear" in the plaintiff [Finding #3209]. Maxwell's December 2021 federal conviction on five of six counts, including sex trafficking of a minor, followed additional testimony in the SDNY criminal case.

Flight logs from September 2002 list passengers including "President Clinton, Kevin Spacey, Chris Tucker, Jeffrey Epstein and the initials GM," and Maxwell's later deposition was asked to confirm that September 2002 Clinton trip [Finding #1351]. In separate depositions, Epstein associates Sarah Kellen, Nadia Marcinkova, and Adriana Ross (Mucinska) invoked the Fifth Amendment when asked about Copperfield, Spacey, and Les Wexner, a response the prosecutor on the record called "absolutely absurd" [Finding #1351]. In her own 2016 deposition, Maxwell stated under oath that "the allegations that Clinton had a meal on Jeffrey's island is 100 percent false" while confirming "I'm sure he had a meal on Jeffrey's plane," and, asked about her relationship with Clinton aide Doug Band, replied "we are talking about adult consensual relationships, it's off the record" [Finding #1319].

On December 8, 2009, Maxwell (sending from "Gmax") emailed Epstein: "If you call I would start by saying what ever you saw was fake and part of a blackmail scheme" [Finding #531][EFTA02434764]. The preserved exchange is one of the few contemporaneous documents in which Maxwell discusses compromising material directly with Epstein.

sections.title: Financial and Banking Record
sections.content:
Court filings in Giuffre v. Maxwell state that Maxwell was on Epstein's Palm Beach house bank account as recently as 2005 (bates Giuffre 007590, pp. 93-95) [Finding #1346]. In January 2006, Forums LLC made a $220,000 internal funds transfer into Maxwell's JPMorgan Private Bank checking account [EFTA01524286]. Forums LLC was one of several Epstein-controlled entities identified during the SDNY and USVI banking investigations. Maxwell sold her townhouse at 116 East 65th Street for $15 million in April 2016, as reported by the New York Post [Finding #1346].

FEC records show three Maxwell contributions [Finding #451]. In September 2004, Maxwell gave two $5,000 contributions to King for Congress (Gary King, New Mexico), listing her address as St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands, and her employment status as "RETIRED" [Finding #451]. Darren Indyke also donated $5,000 to the same committee in 2004 [Finding #451]. Within the Epstein network, the FEC record identifies Maxwell and Indyke as the only donors to King for Congress, during the period in which Epstein's Zorro Ranch operated in New Mexico [Finding #451]. In March 2007, Maxwell donated $2,300 to Hillary Clinton for President, listing herself as "NOT EMPLOYED" from the 10022 ZIP code (Midtown East Manhattan) [Finding #451]. Anthony Barrett (who managed Epstein's 301 East 66th Street building through Ossa Properties) and Richard Kahn (Epstein's co-executor) made donations to the same Clinton committee within months of Maxwell's [Finding #451].

TransUnion records place Ghislaine Noelle Maxwell at 116 East 65th Street from 1995 to 2020 [EFTA01654657]. Indyke purchased that property and is listed as a person associated with the address in LexisNexis records for 2008-2015 [EFTA01295770]. NYC ACRIS property records indicate no entries for Maxwell across the name variants MAXWELL GHISLAINE, MAXWELL GHISLAINE L, and GHISLAINE MAXWELL, which suggests that title to the property was held through an entity or another individual rather than in her own name [Finding #496].

sections.title: Corporate Entities and Trust Structures
sections.content:
Ghislaine Corp. (FL P95000027272, EIN 650590904) was incorporated on April 3, 1995, in Florida as a domestic profit corporation [Finding #515]. Epstein served as both registered agent and President/Director, with Amanda J. Ellison as Secretary at 457 Madison Avenue, New York; the principal address of record was 358 El Brillo Way, Palm Beach [Finding #515]. A name-change amendment on April 21, 1995, renamed the corporation to Ghislaine Corp., implying an earlier name [Finding #515]. The entity was voluntarily dissolved on October 23, 1998 [Finding #515]. From the same 358 El Brillo Way address, Epstein simultaneously operated Financial Strategy Group Inc. (FL P93000087814) [Finding #515].

UK Companies House records list three Maxwell-linked UK entities: Ellmax Enterprise (08321238), Terramar UK (08661523), and Jemma Kidd Make-Up (05340072) [Finding #4905]. Maxwell is recorded as sole director, secretary, and Person of Significant Control of Ellmax at an Orchard End, Fittleton address; as a director of Terramar UK alongside Lucy Clive and Catherine Vaughan-Edwards; and as a director of Jemma Kidd Make-Up at 6100 Red Hook Quarters, U.S. Virgin Islands (an Epstein-linked address) [Finding #4905]. The TerraMar Project, a New York nonprofit focused on ocean conservation that Maxwell founded, co-hosted a June 20, 2013 UN event on oceans and sustainable development goals with Amir Dossal (Global Partnership Forum) and Palau Ambassador Stuart Beck [EFTA02707132]. Masha Drokova, who later co-founded WE Talks with Epstein assistant Lana Pozhidaeva, served as an advisor to TerraMar [EFTA02445716]. The nonprofit was dissolved after Epstein's July 2019 arrest.

Maxwell also held a formal position within Epstein's trust architecture. The First Amendment to the 2001 Trust One, dated June 2003, installed Maxwell as co-trustee in place of Jeffrey Schantz [EFTA01266298]. Documents in GRM Box #004740715 list a Ghislaine Maxwell & 65th Street file that contains a Sotheby's brokerage agreement for the sale of her house, correspondence regarding AIG paying for services of Miller & Raved, and a Pot and Kettle LLC Certificate of Formation and Certificate of Conversion together with an Assignment of Limited Partnership Interest signed by Maxwell and the Duke of York (Prince Andrew) [Finding #2513][EFTA00300480]. The underlying purpose of Pot and Kettle LLC, and the nature of the partnership interest assigned, are not disclosed in available filings.

sections.title: Social and Professional Connections
sections.content:
Email records document Maxwell forwarding Tom Barrack's Colony Capital contact information in August 2004 [EFTA02332968]. This is the earliest Epstein-network document linking Barrack, who was later indicted in 2021 on charges of acting as an unregistered foreign agent for the UAE (he was acquitted at trial in 2022). Separately, a call record in Epstein's materials shows Abe Gosman calling Maxwell on April 27, 2004 [EFTA02332924]; Gosman was the prior owner of the Palm Beach mansion Maison de l'Amitie, which Trump Properties LLC acquired out of his bankruptcy.

Maxwell's documented relationships span legal, corporate, social, financial, and political ties. Les Wexner and Maxwell were co-defendants in the 2002-2003 breach-of-contract action SHANKS v. WEXNER (E.D. Pa. 2:02-cv-07671) [CL:11742516]. Deposition records tie Maxwell to Epstein's executive assistant Lesley Groff and to Natalya Malyshev [DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402696]. In October 2015, former Obama White House Counsel Kathryn Ruemmler forwarded a $50,000 retainer request for Maxwell's legal defense to Epstein, and separately discussed Maxwell/Andrew media strategy with him [EFTA02484900][EFTA02651512]. Maxwell also attended Dolce Vita Parties with Sarah Ferguson to raise money for Children In Crisis and Stow School [EFTA01249207].

Across the documented record, Maxwell's contacts span British aristocracy and royalty (the Duke of York, via the Pot and Kettle LLC documents referenced above [Finding #2513]), U.S. political figures (Clinton, Band), New York society (the Dubins and related philanthropic circles), and members of Epstein's household and assistant staff (Groff, Kellen, Marcinkova). The Priscilla Doe complaint describes Maxwell's role as ensuring "young females were constantly on call to sexually service Epstein" [Finding #3209].

sections.title: Legal Proceedings and Prosecution
sections.content:
Maxwell was arrested on July 2, 2020 in Bradford, New Hampshire, approximately two weeks after Attorney General William Barr moved to replace SDNY U.S. Attorney Geoffrey Berman with SEC Chairman Jay Clayton on June 19, 2020. Berman was removed on June 20 and Maxwell was arrested under Acting U.S. Attorney Audrey Strauss [OffshoreAlert:Ali-Karimi-v-DB]. Barr had stated after Epstein's August 2019 death that "any co-conspirators should not rest easy," and Maxwell is the only Epstein co-conspirator federally charged to date. A subsequent complaint references Maxwell's arrest in New Hampshire one week before a DFS fine announcement, describing her as an alleged Epstein fixer [OffshoreAlert:Ali-Karimi-v-DB]. In December 2021 a Manhattan federal jury convicted Maxwell on five of six counts, including sex trafficking of a minor.

Prior civil litigation documented adjacent facts. The Giuffre v. Maxwell case (SDNY 15-cv-7433) produced the 2016 deposition in which Maxwell stated that Clinton had not visited Epstein's island but had "had a meal on Jeffrey's plane," and declined on-record questioning about her relationship with Doug Band [Finding #1319]. The SHANKS v. WEXNER diversity action (E.D. Pa. 2:02-cv-07671, filed October 2, 2002, terminated October 2003) names Maxwell and Wexner as co-defendants in a breach of contract claim [CL:11742516]; available filings do not disclose the underlying contract. Emails from October 2015 record Kathryn Ruemmler forwarding a $50,000 retainer request for Maxwell's defense to Epstein and separately discussing Maxwell/Andrew media strategy with him [EFTA02484900][EFTA02651512].

The 116 East 65th Street property connects several strands of the legal record. Indyke purchased the property while Maxwell resided there, and LexisNexis person-associate records place him at the same address from 2008 to 2015 [EFTA01295770]. Maxwell lived at the address from 1995 to 2020 per TransUnion records [EFTA01654657]. An examination of NYC ACRIS turned up no records under Maxwell's own name [Finding #496], and she sold the townhouse in April 2016 for $15 million [Finding #1346]. Recipients of the sale proceeds have not been publicly disclosed.

open_questions: What was the original name of Ghislaine Corp. before the April 21, 1995 amendment renamed it? Why was it renamed?
What is the purpose and current status of Pot and Kettle LLC, and what was the nature of the limited partnership interest assigned jointly by Maxwell and Prince Andrew?
How was the 116 East 65th Street property structured -- did Indyke hold it personally, through an entity, or in trust? Who received the $15 million sale proceeds in 2016?
What was the contractual relationship underlying SHANKS v. WEXNER (E.D. Pa. 2:02-cv-07671) in which Maxwell and Wexner were co-defendants?
What role did Forums LLC play as a funding conduit to Maxwell, and were there other entity-to-personal transfers beyond the documented $220,000 in January 2006?
Did Maxwell have accounts or entity interests in offshore jurisdictions (USVI, British Virgin Islands, UK) beyond what has been documented through her St. Thomas address on FEC filings?
What was Kathryn Ruemmler's full scope of work regarding Maxwell -- was the $50,000 retainer the extent of it, or did Latham & Watkins provide broader representation?
What is the full corporate history and purpose of Ellmax, and were there financial flows between Ellmax and Epstein-controlled entities?
